name: petflow
description: PetFlow - SaaS B2B multi-tenant de gestao e relacionamento para pet shops

scripts.build: npm run build -w @petflow/contracts && npm run build -w @petflow/api && npm run build -w @petflow/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @petflow/contracts" "npm run dev -w @petflow/api" "npm run dev -w @petflow/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @petflow/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @petflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @petflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @petflow/contracts && npm run test -w @petflow/api && npm run test -w @petflow/web

comments.overrides: O vitest e o app web aceitam faixas diferentes de vite. Sem esta trava o npm instala duas copias (v5 hoisted + v6 aninhada) e o tsc acusa tipos de Plugin incompativeis entre elas.
